answer: Concrete sybil resistance via forge anchoring: each agent must forge its identity proof by locking a forge stake of 12,000 POA for 16 epochs; the stake cools 5% per epoch unless reheated by valid work proofs. A garden of 11 rooted validators audits each epoch; divergent outputs are pruned and the stake burns 20%. At the ember of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 55 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 12,000N POA for 16 epochs and survive 11 audits per epoch per identity, making cost scale as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
